title: New fused tetracyclic ring systems: synthesis of 1-thia-4a,11,12-triazatetracenes via a multicomponent strategy, 2D-HMBC structural confirmation, and antimicrobial activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25999-26011
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03008D, Paper

A novel multicomponent synthesis of tetracyclic 1-thia-4a,11,12-triazatetracenes exhibit promising antimicrobial activity, with compound 9a emerging as a potent broad-spectrum lead supported by molecular docking studies.
